title: Lyric Edit
description: Herb's Times Square night photo plays as warm, grainy handheld footage while the beat loops. Tap on the beat and the next word of the lyric drops into a white justified block; your taps land on a timeline and Replay plays the edit back exactly in time.
intent: The lyric-edit look from herb's board made playable: one gesture, tapping in time, builds the justified Arial block word by word over blooming, overexposed night footage, and the recording replays in sync with the beat.
